GUIDE: Dev Tools --> Network Tab

Open the dev tools tab with CTRL + SHIFT + J and navigate to the network tab. In firefox, be sure to use CTRL + SHIFT + I

Network panel provides details and insights of a website's remote operation. Because files need to be downloaded from a web server, details specific to individual file transport are presented throughout the panel's interaction.

Examples below are using Edge browser. Chrome and Firefox share similar information and options.

If the findings are needed analyzed at a later time or viewed elsewhere, the import and export (HAR) options allow saving and re-viewing the network data through the import and export HAR functionality.
